title: Four Kids, One BankID, AI Reads Every School Message | vitalii.no
description:
Every school day meant logging into the school portal by hand, checking four separate children's pages for homework and announcements, and reading through long message threads just to figure out what was actually due tomorrow.

The owner now logs in with BankID once, by hand, in a real browser window on the home PC, and that session is captured instead of typed again. A background job polls the school system every 30 minutes during school hours, pulling every pupil's conversations and announcements into one place. AI agents read the new messages and turn vague homework notes into concrete per-child tasks, writing their results through a database role that can only add new rows — it has no way to touch anything else. The same hand-login-then-capture-session trick now also covers a second Norwegian school portal with a completely different login method, so each of the four kids' accounts there got its own automated session too.

One BankID login now keeps four children's school messages, announcements, and homework flowing automatically all day, with homework turned into clear per-child tasks instead of walls of text to re-read every evening.
